sources.name: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data
sources.coverage: England and Wales property sales lodged for registration, 1995-current
sources.update_cadence: Monthly; page states update on the 20th working day
sources.access: Bulk CSV/TXT; monthly, yearly and complete files
sources.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 with address-data reuse restrictions
sources.role: Primary sale price, transaction date, tenure, new-build and address source
sources.limitations: Recent months are incomplete; non-value/unlodged sales excluded; address fields include third-party rights

sources.name: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons
sources.coverage: Registered freehold property indicative extents in England and Wales
sources.update_cadence: Monthly; new files on first Sunday
sources.access: Bulk download by local authority; view service
sources.licence: Open Government Licence with HM Land Registry and Ordnance Survey attribution
sources.role: Primary open parcel/title-index geometry candidate source
sources.limitations: Indicative freehold extents only; not legal boundaries; local-authority boundary duplication possible

sources.name: UK House Price Index data downloads
sources.coverage: Aggregated residential price indices and transaction metrics
sources.licence: Open Government Licence / National Statistics terms
sources.role: Cross-source market-level reasonableness and outlier validation
sources.limitations: Aggregated statistics; not a property or parcel identifier source

sources.name: OS Open UPRN
sources.coverage: Coordinates and UPRNs for addressable locations across Great Britain
sources.licence: OS OpenData terms; free to use
sources.role: Authoritative address identifier and point-location bridge
sources.limitations: Coordinates and identifier only; full address text requires another source

sources.name: OS Open Linked Identifiers
sources.coverage: UPRN, USRN and TOID cross-references across Great Britain
sources.licence: OS OpenData terms; free to use
sources.role: Authoritative identifier linkage for address-road-topography reconciliation
sources.limitations: Lookup relationships; geometry comes from linked products

sources.name: OS Open TOID
sources.coverage: Persistent topographic identifiers and generalised locations across Great Britain
sources.licence: OS OpenData terms; free to use
sources.role: Link candidate parcels/buildings to stable topographic object identifiers
sources.limitations: Generalised locations; detailed MasterMap geometry is not included

sources.name: OS Open USRN
sources.coverage: Unique street reference numbers and simplified street geometry across Great Britain
sources.licence: OS OpenData terms; free to use
sources.role: Street-level address normalisation and access-road consistency
sources.limitations: Street identifier source, not property or title geometry

sources.name: Code-Point Open
sources.coverage: Current postcode units across Great Britain
sources.licence: OS OpenData terms; free to use
sources.role: Postcode centroid fallback and postcode validity checking
sources.limitations: Postcode centroid is not a property coordinate and may span multiple parcels

sources.name: OS Open Names
sources.coverage: Place names, road numbers and postcodes across Great Britain
sources.licence: OS OpenData terms; free to use
sources.limitations: Gazetteer-level location; not a parcel boundary or complete address source

sources.name: Boundary-Line
sources.coverage: Administrative and electoral boundaries across Great Britain
sources.licence: OS OpenData terms; free to use
sources.role: Local-authority partitioning, source-file selection and jurisdiction checks

sources.name: ONS UPRN Directory (ONSUD)
sources.coverage: UPRN allocation to administrative, health and statistical geographies in Great Britain
sources.access: Bulk download from Open Geography portal
sources.licence: ONS/Open Geography licensing with source-specific terms
sources.role: Point-in-polygon geography validation for UPRN candidates
sources.limitations: Requires UPRN input; not a complete address or parcel geometry dataset

sources.name: ONS Postcode Directory (ONSPD)
sources.coverage: Current and terminated UK postcodes linked to administrative and statistical geographies
sources.update_cadence: Quarterly: February, May, August and November
sources.access: Free bulk download from Open Geography portal
sources.role: Postcode validity, historical postcode and geography consistency checks
sources.limitations: Postcode-level point-in-polygon; addresses crossing boundaries inherit mean postcode grid reference

sources.name: Get energy performance of buildings data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.coverage: Domestic/non-domestic EPC and public-building DEC records for England and Wales since 2012
sources.access: Bulk CSV and developer API; GOV.UK One Login required for bulk download
sources.role: Address, building-use, floor-area and certificate cross-source evidence
sources.limitations: Certificates may be expired/replaced; authentication required; not all properties have a current certificate

sources.name: Planning Data Platform API and bulk downloads
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.coverage: Over 100 planning and housing datasets for England
sources.access: JSON/GeoJSON API and bulk CSV/JSON/GeoJSON/Parquet downloads
sources.role: Planning constraints, applications and spatial risk overlays
sources.limitations: Beta; coverage and completeness vary by dataset and local authority

sources.name: Planning Data Title Boundary dataset
sources.publisher: MHCLG platform; source HM Land Registry
sources.update_cadence: Collector-driven; last found date must be monitored
sources.licence: Open Government Licence with HMLR and OS attribution
sources.role: API-friendly title-boundary candidate lookup and geometry intersection
sources.limitations: Platform states some data is created/normalised by MHCLG; freshness may lag direct HMLR INSPIRE

sources.name: Flood Map for Planning – Flood Zones
sources.coverage: Present-day river and sea flood planning zones in England
sources.role: Parcel risk overlay and sale-value plausibility context
sources.limitations: Planning-level indication; not proof that an individual property floods
